title: Treaty of Breslau
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Breslau", at revision 1361189403, opens: "The Treaty of Breslau was a preliminary peace agreement signed on 11 June 1742 following long negotiations at the Silesian capital Breslau by emissaries of Archduchess Maria Theresa of Austria and King Frederick II of Prussia ending the First Silesian War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q700160, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "peace treaty". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
